set_desc: Author FSoundConcurrencySettings on a USoundConcurrency via reflection (partial merge + clamp).
settings_desc: Object of FSoundConcurrencySettings fields to merge (maxCount(int>=1), bLimitToOwner(bool), resolutionRule(enum name), retriggerTime, volumeScale(0..1), volumeScaleMode(enum), bVolumeScaleCanRelease, volumeScaleAttackTime, volumeScaleReleaseTime, voiceStealReleaseTime); absent keys untouched.
get_desc: Read every FSoundConcurrencySettings field (maxCount, bLimitToOwner, resolutionRule, retriggerTime, volume scaling, voice stealing) of a USoundConcurrency asset as one settings object, with the keys set_sound_concurrency_properties takes, plus asset_class. Read-only.
